name: CCPA / CPRA Overlay
description:
Regime overlay for the California Consumer Privacy Act as amended by the CPRA. Carries no membership of its own — it contributes overrides on top of whatever the selected theme policies resolve.

Pair with: the pii theme, and a configuration whose region lens includes US-CA (or US, which covers it hierarchically).

This overlay ships with no overrides yet. It exists so the regime has a stable, selectable identity in the wizard and in configuration summaries, and so the first override authored for it has a home that does not require a catalog restructure. Selecting it today activates the ccpa profile — which the configuration's profile lens can filter rules by — and records the regime in the config's provenance; it does not change any rule's severity or effect.

Scope: CCPA / CPRA — regime identity, no overrides yet
